verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports background automation in the sense of continuous monitoring of sources (Git, Jira, Slack, etc.), hosted/self-hosted scanning, and automated alert routing (Slack, Jira, webhooks) that can run unattended, which fits the 'runs autonomously in the background' part of the story. However, this is generic security-scanning automation, not an AI-agent-specific or LLM-orchestrated automation framework, and there's no evidence of agent-triggered workflows, scheduling APIs, or AI-native orchestration hooks beyond CI/pre-commit hooks and continuous monitoring. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent/LLM-triggered automation setup, scheduling/orchestration API for autonomous runs, and independent confirmation that background monitoring runs reliably unattended.
